name: design-review
tagline_zh: 当你的Go代码被命名、接口、错误处理拖累，它逐项打分并给出可改的修复建议——不是空泛吐槽，而是像资深评审逐行挑刺。
tagline_en: Your Go code gets scored on naming, structure, interfaces, errors—with concrete fixes, not vague praise. A senior.
desc_en: Deep design review of Go codebase — naming, structure, consistency, interfaces, error handling. Scores each dimension and provides actionable fixes.
why_zh: 同类工具只报问题，它给每个维度打分并附上可直接落地的修改，让评审从主观变可量化。
why_en: Unlike generic linters, it scores each dimension and pairs every issue with a concrete fix, turning subjective review into.
